item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Madonna - The Confessions Tour: The Complete Live Album (Fan-Made) [FLAC 16-bit/48.0 kHz]
item.description:
After sharing my fan-made live albums of the Drowned World Tour 2001 and the Sticky & Sweet Tour, I now want to continue with the Confessions Tour, since the official live CD included in the DVD+CD digipak only contains 13 out of 21 tracks.

As I already pointed out in my previous posts about the two live albums I created, I'm not using the track separation from the DVD. Instead, I'm separating the tracks myself using Audacity. For example, the DVD's track separation cuts off the beginning of Forbidden Love, Sorry, and I Love New York. I have to say that finding the right point to make the cuts for Sorry and I Love New York was quite tricky because of the transitions from the previous songs, but I tried my best. Then there are some songs on the DVD where you get unnecessary crowd noise before the song actually starts. This happens with Like It or Not and Let It Will Be. So I adjusted the track separation here as well, so that each song starts exactly where it should.

For this entire project, I used the Linear PCM Stereo audio track from the official DVD and then saved the individual tracks as 16-bit/48 kHz FLAC files in order to preserve the original audio quality.
